astrokit.photoz.colorz module

Quick methods (e.g. Color-z & ML) for photometric redshift estimation. For template fitting, see astrokit.wrapper.eazy.

@author: Rui Zhu @creation time: 2024-04-17

astrokit.photoz.template_fitting module

class astrokit.photoz.template_fitting.SWIRETemplates

Bases: object

使用SWIRE模板库中的模板, 或制作新的模板

Note

  • 可用AGN模板的名称:

    • ‘TQSO1’, ‘QSO1’, ‘BQSO1’, # Type 1 QSO (3)

    • ‘QSO2’, ‘Torus’ # Type 2 QSO (2)

  • 可用星系模板的名称:

    • ‘Ell2’, ‘Ell5’, ‘Ell13’, # 不同年龄的椭圆星系(3)

    • ‘S0’, ‘Sa’, ‘Sb’, ‘Sc’, ‘Sd’, ‘Sdm’, ‘Spi4’ # 漩涡星系(7)

    • ‘M82’, ‘N6090’, ‘N6240’, ‘Arp220’, # Starburst星系(4)

    • ‘I22491’, ‘I19254’, ‘I20551’ # ULIRG星系(3)

    • ‘Sey18’, ‘Sey2’, ‘Mrk231’ # Seyfert星系(3)
